Less-than Or Equal To Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Less-than Or Equal To is 243. Hold Alt, type 243 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Less-than Or Equal To also has the Unicode codepoint U+2264, so you can type it with Alt+8804 on Windows, search for U+2264 in macOS's Character Viewer, use ≤ in HTML, or \2264 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥, for Less-than Or Equal To; shortcuts can differ on other layouts. HTML also defines the named entity ≤ for Less-than Or Equal To, but the numeric form ≤ is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type less-than or equal to on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 2 4 3 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Less-than Or Equal To character (≤) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type less-than or equal to on macOS

On a US keyboard layout, press ⌥, to insert Less-than Or Equal To. This shortcut assumes a US layout; other layouts may remap it.

If the shortcut does not work on your layout, open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Less-Than Or Equal To" and click the character.

How to use less-than or equal to in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\2264"; ()
  • Python: \u2264 or chr(0x2264)
  • JavaScript: \u2264 or String.fromCodePoint(0x2264)
  • JSON: "\u2264"
  • LaTeX: $\leq$ (math mode)

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Less-than Or Equal To?

The legacy Alt code for Less-than Or Equal To is 243. Hold Alt, type 2 4 3 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ≤ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ≤, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+8804 not work?

Alt+8804 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Less-than Or Equal To?

The Unicode codepoint for Less-than Or Equal To is U+2264. You can use this value in HTML as ≤, in CSS as \2264, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ≤ on a Mac?

On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥,. If that does not work on your layout, open ⌃⌘Space and search for U+2264.
